# baffinbay_ip_source (Data Source)

Retrieves a Baffin Bay TPC IP Source by UUID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "baffinbay_ip_source" "tpc" {
  id = "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The UUID of the IP source to retrieve.

### Read-Only

- `cidr` (String)
- `type` (String)
